verdict.rationale: General job or workflow scheduling is outside a 2FA authenticator's category. However, Ente Auth does ship one fixed recurring automation: an optional automatic daily encrypted local backup (ente-auth-docs-8, ente-auth-docs-10). It also points users to its CLI for automatic backups (ente-auth-docs-11, ente-auth-probe-rt-1), though any recurrence there would rely on an external scheduler. missing for 10: user-defined schedules or cadences, arbitrary workflows beyond backups, true background scheduling (the daily backup only runs when the app is opened), and built-in scheduling for CLI jobs.
